source_batch.unit_label: BRBL C U05: Assess cancellation procedure, appeal and continuing investor obligations

facts.statement: Section4 grounds include cessation, investment/registration-condition/direction/account/inspection/prior-approval failures; remedial opportunity is qualified with exceptions and recorded public-interest reasons. Appeal within30days from communication to Central Government; investor repayment obligations can continue after rejection/cancellation.

payload.title: Cancellation is a reasoned regulatory process
payload.core_explanation_md:
The cancellation grounds described in section 4 include cessation of the business and the specified failures concerning investment, registration conditions, directions, accounts, inspection and prior approval. The opportunity to take corrective steps is qualified: its exceptions and the recorded public-interest reasons must be read in the applicable text. Do not simplify this into either a universal hearing guarantee or a claim that every default permits unexplained cancellation.

The described appeal period runs from communication of the order, not a date selected internally. Cancellation or rejection also does not make investor dues vanish; the continuing repayment obligation described in the provision must be tracked. Independent review of the applicable amended procedure remains required.

self_check.prompt_text: Does cancellation by itself extinguish the company investor repayment obligations?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The provision preserves specified obligations despite cancellation or rejection.

payload.stem_md: An ARC removes all investor repayment entries from its books solely because its registration was cancelled. What does section 4 require the reviewer to distinguish?

options.text_md: Cancellation always proves investors were fully repaid
options.explanation_md: The regulatory event is not evidence of actual repayment.

options.text_md: Investor claims become government grants automatically
options.explanation_md: No such conversion follows from the described provision.

options.text_md: Book deletion itself completes the statutory discharge
options.explanation_md: An accounting deletion cannot establish discharge of liabilities.

options.text_md: Loss of regulatory registration and continuing investor repayment obligations
options.explanation_md: The provision keeps specified repayment obligations despite rejection/cancellation.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The provision keeps specified repayment obligations despite rejection/cancellation.

payload.stem_md: A cancellation checklist says either every case must receive identical corrective time or no case needs recorded reasons. Which approach is defensible?

options.text_md: Choose whichever version saves staff time
options.explanation_md: Convenience does not resolve the statutory conditions.

options.text_md: Read the grounds, qualified opportunity, exceptions and recorded-reason requirement together
options.explanation_md: The procedure is conditional and cannot be reduced to either absolute statement.

options.text_md: Use the asset market value as the only procedural rule
options.explanation_md: Valuation does not establish cancellation procedure.

options.text_md: Ignore the communication date for appeal timing
options.explanation_md: The described appeal period is tied to communication of the order.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The procedure is conditional and cannot be reduced to either absolute statement.
